items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5603

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to create a temporary New York state War of 1812 200th
anniversary commemoration commission to promote the 200th anniversary
of the War of 1812


 PURPOSE :
To create a temporary New York state War of 1812 Bicentennial
commemoration commission to promote the two centuries of peace between
the United States and Canada which will take place between the years
2012 and 2014 in New York state.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1. The legislature hereby finds that there is a need to create
a New York state War of 1812 Bicentennial commemoration commission.
Section 2. The commission is to be known as the "New York state War of
1812 Bicentennial commemoration commission". Section 3. The commission
shall consist of 19 members.

 JUSTIFICATION :
During the years 2012 - 2014, New York state will celebrate the
bicentennial of the War of 1812 and two centuries of unbroken peace
with Canada. During the years 1812-1814, New York's northern and
western "frontiers" were the front lines of the last great war between
the United States and the Kingdom of Great Britain.  In an era when
the Great Lakes and the St.  Lawrence River marked the boundary
between two hostile nations and the United States fought its "Second
War of Independence," the citizens of New York state endured more
hardship and engaged in more combat than any other state in the young
nation. Indeed, the American victory in that conflict was won on the
fields, rivers, and lakes of New York State.

New York State, its counties, cities, towns and villages may profit,
both culturally and economically, from the benefits of a statewide
commission to help organize, promote and fully implement a major
commemoration of the War of 1812.

This commission will engage cross border cooperation with the Province
of Ontario, Canada for the promotion of mutual heritage tourism and
exploration of regional cultural, historic, and outdoor recreation
activities.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
